meta.title: zlak-flow
meta.description: Adds a zlak-flow entry to the left sidebar that opens the PM/Reviewer build workflow: a task box with an optional coder profile and model alias seeds the /zlak-flow command into a new session, and the same page documents the six phases and their approval gates, the role values that move Plan and Review to another model, the flags, the coder transport lanes (Anthropic-compatible, OpenAI-compatible, or any CLI), the size limits, the .zlak-flow file layout, and the adoption labels. The bundle also registers the /zlak-flow command for runs started from the composer. Nothing is tied to one vendor: any provider, model or CLI the profile can reach can be the planner, the reviewer or the coder. Limits: the page launches and explains the run but does not read .zlak-flow state files, so progress and pending approvals stay in the conversation; gates hold only because the model follows the protocol, since no hook enforces them; Phase 3 needs a coder mechanism the profile provides and stops with a message when none exists; .zlak-flow/coder.json is a convention, not a validated schema. Only Phase 5 commits, and the plugin never pushes, never reads credentials, and makes no network requests of its own.
